result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a high-visibility continental crosswalk across two travel lanes. While sidewalks and basic markings are present, the wide roadway and lack of active pedestrian warning systems or traffic calming measures increase exposure risk.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross two wide travel lanes without a median refuge or curb extensions to shorten the exposure time.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Warning Signage
hazards.description: There are no visible signs alerting approaching drivers to the presence of the pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the crossing to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install W11-2 pedestrian crossing warning signs or R1-6 in-street signs to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated amber LEDs to the crossing signs to significantly increase driver yielding rates.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk across the side street. However, the intersection lacks pedestrian-specific signals and the crosswalk markings appear somewhat faded, increasing exposure in a relatively wide crossing area.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The intersection is controlled by a traffic signal but lacks dedicated walk/don't-walk indicators for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: On the signal pole at the right corner

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk markings are worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the side street in the middle ground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features a signalized crossing with pedestrian signals but lacks marked crosswalks, creating a significant gap in pedestrian infrastructure. The wide roadway and residential context suggest a need for better-defined crossing areas and traffic calming measures to protect vulnerable road users.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: Despite the presence of pedestrian signals, there are no painted crosswalk markings on the pavement to alert drivers to the crossing location.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection foreground.

hazards.name: Wide Travel Lanes
hazards.description: The wide, open roadway design may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential area, increasing risk for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway stretching into the distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Ensure all corners have detectable warning surfaces and proper slopes for accessibility.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with fragmented sidewalk infrastructure and a lack of formal pedestrian crossing facilities. While the low-density residential setting may imply lower traffic volumes, the absence of marked crosswalks and curb ramps at a signalized intersection creates a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalk
hazards.description: There is no marked crossing at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without a designated space.

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The lack of curb ramps makes the intersection inaccessible for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk near the traffic light

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Construct ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all corners of the intersection to ensure accessibility.
